findings.claim: New required `title: string` member added to `JobSummaryOptions` — every place that constructs a full `JobSummaryOptions` value (the defaults/merge object) must now supply a default, otherwise `title` is `undefined` at runtime despite its non-optional type.
findings.rationale: The public option is `Partial<JobSummaryOptions>`, so users may omit `title`. The documented `@default 'Vitest Test Report'` only takes effect if the reporter actually merges a default in. If the resolution code does something like `{ ...defaults, ...options.jobSummary }` where `defaults` is typed loosely (or is cast), a missing default would silently yield `undefined` and render an empty/`undefined` heading in the job summary. Cannot verify from this hunk alone; medium confidence that the default wiring needs checking.

findings.claim: User-supplied `title` is interpolated into GitHub job-summary Markdown without any stated escaping/sanitization constraints.
findings.rationale: A title containing newlines, `#`, backticks or HTML could break out of the intended heading and corrupt the rest of the generated summary. Worth confirming the render site escapes or at least strips newlines. Low-to-medium confidence since the render code is not shown here.
